patches.why: The web build had no crash recovery: unsaved work was lost on reload. Unsaved drawings are copied to IndexedDB (craft-web-recovery) and offered back after a reload or crash in Drawing Recovery; also, a restored profile no longer makes the new empty drawing look unsaved

craft-web-recovery: crash-recovery copies of unsaved documents in the browser (IndexedDB, one Web Lock per tab, counted only after commit), the unload guard and download helpers; shared by every app's web save fixes, not in storytold's craft-libs yet (storytold/craft-libs#124)
